  Bendigo | 12-Month Contract | Highly Attractive Daily Rates  
   
 An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Senior Project Engineer to join a leading global defence organisation supporting a significant land systems program. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment, you will play a key role in the delivery of complex capability projects from concept through to production and integration. 
   
 This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys balancing technical design responsibilities with project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and engineering governance. 
     
  Your new role  
   
 As a Senior Project Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of engineering activities across a complex defence program. You will work closely with design, systems, manufacturing and project management teams to ensure technical outcomes are delivered on time, within budget and to the required standards. 
   
 A key part of this role will involve the development and management of engineering designs and documentation using Creo or CAD and associated product lifecycle management tools.    Key Responsibilities  
   
 
 Coordinate engineering activities across the project lifecycle. 
 Support project planning, scheduling and technical risk management. 
 Develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies and engineering documentation. 
 Create and maintain 3D CAD models and technical drawings using Creo or CAD. 
 Manage engineering change processes and design modifications. 
 Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure project objectives are achieved. 
 Support design reviews, verification and validation activities. 
 Ensure compliance with defence, quality and engineering standards. 
 Collaborate with manufacturing and production teams to support successful delivery outcomes. 
 
      
  What you'll need to succeed  
   
   
 
 Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a related discipline. 
 Demonstrated experience working as a Project Engineer within defence, aerospace, heavy vehicle, manufacturing or other complex engineering environments. 
 Strong mechanical design experience. 
 Strong experience using PTC Creo or CAD for 3D modelling and design activities. 
 Experience producing and managing engineering drawings, BOMs and technical documentation. 
 Exposure to PLM systems such as Windchill would be highly regarded. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills. 
 Ability to work within multidisciplinary engineering teams and manage competing priorities. 
 
   
       
  What you'll get in return  
   
   
 
 Long-term contract opportunity with strong likelihood of extension 
 Highly competitive daily rates 
 Opportunity to work on a nationally significant defence capability program. 
 Bendigo location with a flexible and collaborative team environment. 
 Exposure to advanced engineering and cutting-edge defence technologies.

result.description:
Job Title: Control Room Operator (Engineering Technologist ANZSCO 233914)
Company: Scidell Pty Ltd, an associated entity of Multicom Resources Pty Ltd
Location: St Elmo Site, Julia Creek QLD 4823, Australia
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

About the company:
Our client Scidell Pty Ltd is a newly formed scientific delivery alliancing company of Multicom Resources Pty Ltd. Scidell is dedicated to providing cost-effective solutions to Multicom Resources, its foundation alliance client, while also seeking opportunities to expand its services.

Multicom Resources is a Queensland-based exploration and minerals refining company focused on discovering and developing world-class mineral deposits. Among its key projects is the Saint Elmo Project, located in the Northwest Minerals Province of Queensland. This project is advancing the production of vanadium and high-purity alumina, essential resources for global technology manufacturers.

About the role:
As a Control Room Operator at Scidell, you will play a vital role in the operations of the Saint Elmo Mine's mineral processing plant. Reporting to the Plant Manager, this position involves monitoring and optimizing plant equipment using advanced HMI systems and automated controls. You’ll be instrumental in ensuring plant safety, efficiency, and compliance with production goals and regulatory standards.
This is a full-time role operating on a rotating roster.

Key Requirements:
-A minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar role, such as a Control Room Operator, or within a related field, such as mining or mineral processing.
-A demonstrated ability to quickly learn and apply knowledge about process plant operations.
-Proficiency in operating and troubleshooting HMI and automated control systems (e.g., DCS, SCADA).
-Strong problem-solving skills to assess process disturbances and implement corrective actions effectively.
-Attention to detail to monitor plant conditions and identify operational changes.
-A commitment to maintaining safety and compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities:
-Monitor and control plant equipment using modern HMI and automated systems to ensure efficient and safe operations.
-Detect and respond to changes in process conditions and troubleshoot equipment issues.
-Collaborate with field operators and maintenance personnel to resolve process disruptions.
-Coordinate plant start-ups, shutdowns, and emergency operations to minimize downtime.
-Review plant performance data to identify trends and implement process optimizations.
-Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to enhancing plant efficiency.
-Maintain compliance with safety protocols and assist in training new operators.

Why Join Us?
Scidell offers a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge mineral processing projects while working in a supportive and collaborative environment. Be part of a team that values innovation, safety, and excellence in delivering critical minerals to global markets.

How to Apply:
If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team at Scidell Pty Ltd, dedicated to innovation and excellence, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your application, ensuring you highlight your relevant experience and qualifications.

Scidell Pty Ltd is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. While we appreciate every application, please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

result.description: Black EME Pty Ltd  At Black & More, we employ the right people and shape careers around their strengths and ambitions. We're looking for an early-career engineer who's ready to take on more responsibility, gain exposure to a broad range of projects, and grow into a future leader.  The ideal applicant will fulfil a technically oriented role, whereby you'll:   Prepare civil engineering designs, drawings and technical documentation for projects including roads, subdivisions, stormwater drainage, bridges and major culverts, ensuring compliance with relevant Australian Standards and client requirements.   Develop engineering specifications, determine appropriate construction methods and materials, and provide technical advice throughout the design and delivery of projects.   Undertake site inspections, construction surveillance and quality assurance activities to verify works are completed in accordance with approved designs, specifications and contractual requirements.   Assist with project planning, cost estimating, tender documentation, contract administration and the assessment of design changes and variations throughout the project lifecycle.   Analyse engineering data, site investigations and technical information to develop practical, safe and sustainable engineering solutions for civil infrastructure projects.   Liaise with clients, contractors, government authorities and other stakeholders to coordinate project activities and provide technical engineering support.   Contribute to design reviews, risk assessments and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure engineering outcomes meet safety, quality and project objectives.   You'll be supported by experienced engineers and encouraged to develop your technical, project management, and client-facing skills. The ideal applicant will have a clear aspiration to achieve RPEQ registration and a desire to make a real impact through their work.   Requirements    Civil Engineering degree qualification is required.  3 years of professional experience.  Strong verbal communication skills to be able to present and articulate ideas to a wide variety of stakeholders.  Ability to meet timeframes.  A client-focused approach to problem-solving.  Ability to work as part of a team.  The drive to continue to develop their expertise.  A current driver's licence.    What's in it for you?   If you're motivated by ownership, responsibility, and the opportunity to make a tangible difference, you belong at Black & More and will benefit from our industry-leading employment packages, including:   Competitive remuneration and company bonus program suited to your level of experience  Opportunity to work on a wide range of civil and structural engineering projects with potential travel across Queensland  Direct supervision by Principal Civil and Structural Engineers and support from other engineers and civil designers  Flexible working arrangements, including study leave if applicable  Training and development opportunities that exceed minimum CPD requirements  Access to cutting-edge tools, technology, and professional memberships  Potential to work from our other offices and travel for work  Profit share and performance rewards recognising team achievements  Employee wellbeing support through our Employee Assistance Program  Regular team events for social connection and networking   Because when you're driven by purpose and focused on creating value, the rewards naturally follow.  About Company    We are a professional engineering and project management business that has operated successfully for over 25 years. With offices in Cairns, Toowoomba, Brisbane, Atherton and the Sunshine Coast, we practice Civil and Structural Engineering with a Project Management focus. At Black & More, we look for people who want to own their work, deliver great projects, and grow into professionals who make a difference to society. result.description: Savic Motorcycles Limited   About the Role   We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design, develop, validate and improve the mechanical systems, components and manufacturing processes of the Savic C-Series electric motorcycle platform. This is an engineering role covering the full product lifecycle, from concept design through to production readiness, with genuine ownership of components and systems on a market-leading Australian-designed electric motorcycle.   Key Responsibilities    Design, develop and optimise mechanical components, assemblies and vehicle systems for the Savic C-Series platform and upcoming models, including chassis, suspension, bodywork, mounting systems and structural components.  Translate performance, durability, safety and manufacturing requirements into engineering specifications, drawings, tolerances and technical documentation.  Develop manufacturing-ready designs using Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles, GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis and material selection.  Perform and support engineering analysis including finite element analysis, fatigue analysis and topology optimisation, and develop and execute mechanical test plans and validation procedures.  Support the transition of designs from prototype to repeatable, production-ready manufacture, including release of manufacturing drawings, work instructions and inspection requirements.  Design or support the development of jigs, fixtures, gauges and other production aids to improve quality, safety and repeatability.  Maintain Engineering Change Management records, Bills of Materials, drawing releases and New Product Introduction documentation, including DFMEA, PFMEA and PPAP activities.  Lead FRACAS Meetings focusing on analysis, quality assurance and continuous improvement functions of mechanical components, in alignment with the software, systems and electrical engineering teams.    Support structured root-cause analysis and corrective action processes and maintain fault and corrective action records in Notion or other nominated engineering systems.  Identify opportunities to improve cost, manufacturability, weight and performance of components and assemblies, and evaluate alternative materials and manufacturing methods.  Work closely with Electrical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, Quality and Aftersales teams to ensure mechanical systems integrate effectively with the wider vehicle platform.    What We're Looking For    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  Demonstrated experience designing, developing and validating mechanical components, assemblies or systems in an automotive, motorcycle, EV, manufacturing, aerospace, robotics or related product-development environment.  Strong capability in mechanical design for manufacture, including GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, materials selection, manufacturing drawings and production documentation.  Experience with engineering analysis and validation methods, including FEA, fatigue assessment, physical testing, data acquisition or structured test planning.  Experience applying engineering quality and risk-management methods such as DFMEA, PFMEA, 8D, 5D, DMAIC, DFSS, PPAP or equivalent.  Experience supporting engineering change management, BOM control, drawing release and New Product Introduction processes.  Strong practical understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling, jigs, fixtures, machining, casting, fabrication or assembly methods.  Proficient with CAD, PLM/PDM, project management, engineering documentation and issue-tracking systems; experience with Notion, Jira, Odoo or equivalent systems is highly regarded.    Our Brand   In this role, you will act in accordance with our brand values and help us deliver our brand vision: to make EV riding enjoyable to every rider in the world.   We put people first — our customers are at the heart of what we do.  We design in Australia — being an Aussie brand is in our DNA.  We make informed decisions — using data, insights and experience.  We actually care — each person is personally passionate about what we're doing.      About Company      Savic Motorcycles is redefining the electric motorcycle industry with premium, high-performance machines that blend cutting-edge technology, sleek design and an exclusive brand experience. Our Engineering team is responsible for ensuring Savic motorcycles are safe, reliable, manufacturable, commercially viable, and continuously improving as the business scales. About SideTippers Australia:

SideTippers Australia is a leading Australian manufacturer of premium side tippers and heavy transport equipment, supplying innovative solutions to the mining, agricultural, civil construction and transport industries. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality workmanship, reliable products and exceptional customer service. Due to continued growth, we are seeking a skilled and motivated Welder (First Class) to join our manufacturing team in Chadwick, Western Australia.

Responsibilities:

The Welder (First Class) is responsible for the fabrication, assembly, repair and maintenance of heavy transport equipment and fabricated steel components, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with engineering specifications, Australian Standards and company quality requirements.

Tasks:

•	Bring equipment, trailers and components into the workshop for fabrication, modification or repair.
•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications and cut lists to determine fabrication requirements.
•	Assess fabrication and repair work and plan welding and fabrication projects accurately to ensure efficient production outcomes.
•	Prepare, measure, cut, shape and align metal sections using hand tools, grinders, flame-cutting equipment and fabrication machinery.
•	Perform MIG, TIG and arc welding to manufacture, assemble, repair and modify trailers, heavy transport equipment and structural steel components.
•	Join metal sections using welding, bolting and riveting techniques where required.
•	Inspect completed welds to ensure quality, strength, penetration and compliance with engineering specifications.
•	Finish fabricated products by grinding, cleaning and polishing to achieve a high-quality finish.
•	Operate workshop equipment safely and maintain tools, machinery and equipment in good working order.
•	Work collaboratively with the workshop team to meet production schedules while maintaining a clean, organised and safe work environment.
•	Comply with all workplace health and safety procedures, company policies and quality standards.

Qualifications:

•	Trade qualification as a Welder (First Class), Engineering Tradesperson (Fabrication), or equivalent recognised qualification.
•	Current driver's licence is desirable.

Skills:

•	Proficiency in MIG, TIG and arc welding techniques.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints and technical specifications.
•	Strong fabrication, metalworking and problem-solving skills.
•	High attention to detail with a commitment to producing quality workmanship.
•	Strong organisational skills with the ability to plan and prioritise fabrication tasks effectively.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
•	Strong commitment to workplace health and safety and safe work practices.

Experience:

•	Minimum 2 years' post-trade experience as a Welder (First Class) or in a similar fabrication role.
•	Experience manufacturing, repairing and modifying heavy machinery, trailers, transport equipment or structural steel.
•	Proven ability to work from engineering drawings and cut lists to produce accurate, high-quality fabrication work.
•	Experience operating workshop fabrication equipment and working in a heavy engineering or manufacturing environment.
•	Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver quality work while meeting production deadlines and company standards.

SALARY: $79,499 to $82,992 PER ANNUM
